[P2] Remove the unimplemented batch-result guarantee

`BatchResult.succeeded()` and `get_results()` in `concurrency/models.py` still filter on `item.result is not None`, and this PR leaves those filters unchanged. Successful branches returning `None` and `"ok"` still produce `["ok"]`, so consumers relying on the documented one-entry-per-success behavior can miscount or misassociate outputs. Remove this claimed breaking change, or include the status-only filtering implementation with tests covering successful `None` results.
